responsibility: Implements predicate analysis for deriving and comparing control-dependent boolean conditions on CFG paths. It builds normalized predicate chains from branch/control-dependence information, simplifies and factors them, computes predicates guarding PHI definitions and uses, and answers whether a use is protected by conditions that exclude undefined or uninitialized incoming values; this logic is primarily used by SSA diagnostics such as uninitialized-use analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements predicate construction, normalization, simplification, control-dependence traversal, and guarded-use analysis algorithms, whereas the header defines the predicate data structures and the uninit_analysis interface only.
